zh.title: Austrian Airlines空中巴士A320遭炸彈威脅轉降索菲亞，戰機護航
zh.summary: Austrian Airlines航班遭炸彈威脅轉降索菲亞，檢查未發現危險
body: Austrian Airlines一架從特拉維夫飛往維也納的航班，於2026年10月18日因炸彈威脅轉降保加利亞索菲亞，並由保加利亞戰機護航。航班編號OS82，機上有51名乘客及6名機組人員。
搜索未發現危險；空中巴士A320其後載著所有乘客續飛維也納。保加利亞交通部表示，機組在羅馬尼亞邊境附近通報威脅後決定轉降。奧地利內政部長Gerhard Karner表示，事件正在調查中。

en.title: Austrian Airlines A320 diverts to Sofia under fighter escort after bomb threat
en.summary: Austrian Airlines diverted to Sofia after a bomb threat; checks found no danger.
body: An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna diverted to Sofia, Bulgaria, on October 18, 2026, after a bomb threat, under Bulgarian fighter escort. Flight OS82 was carrying 51 passengers and six crew members, the airline said.

A search found no danger, and the Airbus A320 later continued to Vienna with all passengers aboard. Bulgaria’s Transport Ministry said the crew reported the threat near the Romanian border and decided to divert to Sofia. Austrian Interior Minister Gerhard Karner said an investigation was underway.

zh.title: 烏克蘭部隊以重型無人機撤離傷兵，軍方稱為戰場首例
zh.summary: 烏克蘭部隊以無人機撤離前線傷兵，製造商稱任務歷時約75分鐘
body: 烏克蘭部隊使用重型無人機，將一名傷兵從前線位置空運撤離；AeroTime報導，當地地雷與俄羅斯無人機活動使地面救援受阻。此次任務使用烏克蘭製造商Gurzuf Defence打造的六旋翼 Heavy Shot Ayudag-6。
第92獨立突擊旅專家與Gurzuf合作調整無人機，並測試改裝，目標是避免載人時機體過度傾斜或搖晃。第30旅無人機操作員其後將傷兵飛至安全地點，地面部隊接應並安排後續送醫。
製造商表示，任務歷時約75分鐘、飛行62公里。軍方與製造商稱這是全球首例此類戰場撤離，但該說法尚未獲獨立查證。

en.title: Ukraine Uses Heavy Drone to Evacuate Wounded Soldier; Military Calls It a First
en.summary: Ukrainian troops evacuate a wounded soldier by drone; manufacturer says the mission lasted about 75 minutes
body: Ukrainian troops used a heavy drone to airlift a wounded soldier from a frontline position, where mines and Russian drone activity had prevented a ground rescue, AeroTime reported. The operation involved a six-rotor Heavy Shot Ayudag-6, built by Ukrainian manufacturer Gurzuf Defence.

Specialists from the 92nd Separate Assault Brigade worked with Gurzuf to adapt the drone and test changes intended to prevent excessive tipping or swaying while carrying a person. A drone operator from the 30th Brigade then flew the soldier to safety; troops met him and arranged further evacuation to a hospital.

The manufacturer said the mission lasted about 75 minutes and covered 62 kilometers. The military and manufacturer described it as the world’s first such battlefield evacuation, although that claim has not been independently verified.

zh.title: 利雅德國王哈立德國際機場重開 航空公司延長停飛
zh.summary: 利雅德國王哈立德國際機場重開，多家航空公司延長取消航班或延後服務
body: 利雅德的國王哈立德國際機場於10月18日（星期日）重開，結束逾一週的營運中斷，並恢復有限度營運。多家國際航空公司已將取消航班安排延長至11月，另有航空公司把服務延期至2027年。
截至10月19日，國王哈立德國際機場仍有兩項限制性航空通告生效。A3650/26要求所有抵達及離場航空器事先取得Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation許可；A3651/26則禁止航空公司將利雅德列為預定備降機場。兩項通告自10月17日起生效，未訂明到期日。

en.title: King Khalid International Airport Reopens, but Airlines Extend Cancellations
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport reopened, but airlines extended cancellations and delayed service resumptions.
body: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh reopened on Sunday, 18 October, after more than a week of disruption. The airport has resumed limited operations, but several international carriers have extended cancellations into November, while others have postponed services until 2027.

As of 19 October, two restrictive aviation notices remained in force at King Khalid International Airport. NOTAM A3650/26 requires all arriving and departing aircraft to obtain prior permission from Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation. NOTAM A3651/26 prohibits airlines from using Riyadh as a planned diversion airport. Both notices took effect on 17 October and have no specified expiry date.
